failure_summary.description: The answer identified the right entity but added a generic or unnecessary word, or used a noncanonical spelling.
The agent chose a related entity, category label, or denomination instead of following the clue's requested target or attribute.
The agent repeated a Spoonerism instead of recovering the intended phrase.

patch.reasoning: Most failures are already covered by rules on target selection, requested attributes, metadata, and minimal conventional answer forms, so adding those again would be redundant. Add one focused rule for interpreting Spoonerism clues, which the current skill does not explicitly address.

edits.target: For compact definition or wordplay clues that give two linked readings, solve the whole clue for the conventional term satisfying both; do not merely restate one reading. Preserve an article when it is part of the expected expression.
edits.content: For a Spoonerism clue that asks what a speaker meant or intended, reverse the transposed sounds (typically the initial sounds) to recover the intended phrase; do not repeat the Spoonerism unless the clue asks what was said.
